description: List the files sent with create_mailbox_batch, newest first, a page at a time: each one's name, who sent it, how many rows it has in each state (`queued`, `checking`, `connected`, `skipped`, `failed`) and `running`, true while a row is queued or checking. It never carries a row's address, cells or logins: open one with get_mailbox_batch. A file is kept 7 days. It needs setup permission. A signed-in owner has it and can give it to an API key for the whole workspace. That key loses it if its maker stops being the owner.

cursor.description: Where the last page stopped: the nextCursor of the answer before. Use it with the same filters it came with. Left out, the list starts at the beginning.

limit.description: How many to return in one page, 1 to 200. Left out, the server picks.

name: list_mailbox_batches
title: List files of mailboxes
